data.name: River Champion
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, three times per day as a standard action, you can sculpt water into the form of a melee weapon with which you are proficient (typically a trident, but it could also take the form of a dagger or another light weapon). You must have enough water to form the weapon, an amount equal to the weapon's normal weight. Once formed, the weapon behaves as a weapon of its type with an enhancement bonus of +%1. This weapon deals double the normal amount of damage to creatures with the fire subtype. The weapon dissolves into ordinary water after %2 rounds or as soon as it leaves your hand, whichever happens first.|min(4,TL/5)|TL
